summary: Seabridge Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the execution of an unsecured, short-term loan agreement for up to US$100 million with a strategic investor. The facility bears 7% interest compounded monthly and matures on December 31, 2026. Draws are in minimum $10 million increments. The loan is repayable in cash or, subject to TSX approval, in common shares at the company's option. Proceeds support summer work at its KSM project. No amounts are currently drawn. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation, so the filing does not trigger a special-situation classification.
